entries.title: Desktop Cloud – University of Quindío
entries.description:
Thesis project focused on providing virtual desktops accessible from anywhere using open-source technologies.

I led the design and implementation of the backend in Golang, creating authentication flows, session management, and remote connections. I also integrated the desktop client, enabling real-time synchronization.

I gained hands-on experience in environment virtualization, containerization with Docker, and database management with MariaDB, all under principles of scalability, modularity, and security.

entries.title: Business Applications – Freelance
entries.description:
I have developed various fullstack applications combining technologies such as React, .NET, Golang, and Java, focused on efficiency, clean architecture, and usability.

I explored REST API design, accessible interfaces, and deployment in resource-constrained environments. These experiences strengthened my autonomy, adaptability, and practical approach to real-world solutions.

0.title: El Búho Sabio
0.description:
An educational platform focused on critical reading for elementary school children.
Developed with React, Tailwind, and Firebase for the frontend, and Golang for the backend.
Includes authentication, interactive exercise system, and an admin panel.

1.title: NexBoard
1.description:
Monitoring dashboard for hardware and software metrics.
Built with React, Tailwind, Node.js, and Golang.
Communicates with a local client that collects system data and sends it via a RESTful API.
Data is visualized using Chart.js and stored with SQLite.
